diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index b38158f..50f2efc 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -87,6 +87,54 @@ class TestQtArgs:
         for arg in ['--foo', '--bar']:
             assert arg in args
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, expected', [
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine,
+         ['--other', '--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo,ConfigOne,OverlayScrollbar']),
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit,
+         ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo', '--other',
+          '--enable-features=ConfigOne']),
+    ])
+    def test_existing_features_from_cli_and_config(self, config_stub,
+                                                   monkeypatch, parser,
+                                                   backend, expected):
+        """Combine all WebEngine features while retaining WebKit arguments."""
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend', backend)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', False)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['other', 'enable-features=ConfigOne']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([
+            '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo'])
+
+        assert qtargs.qt_args(parsed) == [sys.argv[0]] + expected
+
+    def test_multiple_feature_entries_without_overlay(self, config_stub,
+                                                      monkeypatch, parser):
+        """Merge repeated feature flags even when no configured feature exists."""
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',
+                            usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['enable-features=ConfigOne,ConfigTwo']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([
+            '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliOne',
+            '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliTwo'])
+
+        assert qtargs.qt_args(parsed) == [
+            sys.argv[0],
+            '--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo,ConfigOne,ConfigTwo']
+
+    def test_helper_merges_feature_flags(self, config_stub, parser):
+        """Split each input flag into features for the WebEngine helper."""
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([])
+
+        args = list(qtargs._qtwebengine_args(parsed, [
+            '--enable-features=First,Second', '--enable-features=Third']))
+        assert [arg for arg in args if arg.startswith('--enable-features=')] == [
+            '--enable-features=First,Second,Third']
+        assert list(qtargs._qtwebengine_enabled_features([
+            '--enable-features=First,Second', '--enable-features=Third'])) == [
+            'First', 'Second', 'Third']
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, expected', [
         (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine, True),
         (usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit, False),
